requirements.description: Published and candidate capabilities stay distinct in EN and FR.
acceptance_criteria: Every page identifies released 0.1.3 and candidate 0.2.0; translated routes correspond.

requirements.description: Documentation navigation works with keyboard, pointer and no JavaScript.
acceptance_criteria: Search supports filtering, arrows, Enter, Escape, focus confinement and restoration without capturing editable fields or native shortcuts.

requirements.description: One authored Markdown source produces consistent HTML, Markdown and machine discovery.
acceptance_criteria: All listed resources and internal links resolve over HTTP, Markdown bodies match their source, and schema/example digests validate.

requirements.description: The interface remains readable in both themes and at narrow widths or enlarged text.
acceptance_criteria: All pages reflow at 320, 390, 768 and 1440 pixels; text scales to 200%; color tokens pass WCAG text contrast and reduced motion is respected.

requirements.description: Pinned build tooling checks review branches without deployment.
acceptance_criteria: The Hugo checksum, Node version, exact development dependencies and full-SHA Actions are pinned; PR validation has read-only permissions and no deploy step.
